questions.stem: Pointing to a photo, A says, 'She is the daughter of my grandfather's only son.' How is the girl related to A?

options.option_text: Cousin to A in the photo
Sister to A in the photo
Niece to A in the photo
Aunt to A in the photo

questions.explanation: 'My grandfather's only son' = A's father (since A is grandfather's grandchild via this only son). So girl = daughter of A's father = SISTER of A. Distractor 1 — cousin would require uncle/aunt. Distractor 3 — niece is daughter of A's sibling (A's daughter is A's daughter). Distractor 4 — aunt would be grandfather's daughter.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: X is the brother of Y. Y is the son of Z. Z is the wife of W. What is X to W?

options.option_text: Nephew of W in the family
Son of W in the family
Brother of W in the family
Father of W in the family

questions.explanation: Y is son of Z (mother). Z is wife of W → W is Y's FATHER. X is Y's brother → X is also W's son. So X to W = SON. Distractors are wrong relationships from the chain.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: P's mother is Q's daughter. Q's son R has only sister S. How is P related to S?

options.option_text: Niece or nephew (S is P's aunt)

questions.explanation: Q has children: P's mother + R (R is Q's son). R has 'only sister' S → S is also Q's daughter. So Q's daughters = P's mother + S. Hence S is P's mother's SISTER → P's MATERNAL AUNT. P is S's NIECE/NEPHEW. (Whether nephew or niece depends on P's gender, which isn't given.)
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: Pointing to a man, a woman says, 'His mother is the only daughter of my mother.' How is the woman related to that man?

options.option_text: Aunt of the man (the man's mother's sister)
Mother of the man (the woman is herself the daughter)
Cousin of the man, in the same generation
Grandmother of the man, two generations up

questions.explanation: 'Only daughter of my mother' = the woman HERSELF (assuming woman is her mother's only daughter). So 'his mother' = the woman speaking. Hence woman = man's MOTHER. (Trick puzzle — students often answer 'aunt'.) Always test: 'only daughter of my mother' = the speaker herself.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: A is B's father. B is C's mother. D is C's brother. E is D's father. How is A related to E?
questions.explanation: C has parents B (mother) + 'someone' (father). D is C's brother → D has same parents as C. E is D's father → E = D's + C's father. So E is married to B (since B is C's mother). A is B's father → A is E's wife's father → A = E's FATHER-IN-LAW.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: Pointing to a boy, Anita said, 'He is the son of my father's only sister's husband.' The boy is Anita's:
questions.explanation: 'My father's only sister' = Anita's PATERNAL AUNT (बुआ / phupi). Her HUSBAND = Anita's UNCLE BY MARRIAGE (फूफा / phupha). His son = Anita's COUSIN (specifically, cousin via paternal aunt). Note: 'son of aunt's husband' = aunt's son IF the husband + aunt have biological children (assumed default). Distractor 1 = brother is sibling (own father's son). Distractor 3 = nephew is from a sibling.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: If A's father is B's mother's husband, and C is the daughter of A, how is C related to B?
questions.explanation: B's mother's husband = B's FATHER. A's father = B's father → A + B share a father → A + B are SIBLINGS (or half-siblings, but treat as siblings). C is A's daughter → C is A's child. Since A is B's sibling, C is B's NIECE.
